purpose: Back to Brainfuck from a new starting point, to see whether a few more eight-symbol rules make the thing I wrote clearer.

pages.title: Brianfuck
pages.reaction: A Brainfuck joke that turns into a list of tiny eight-symbol programs, and the page admits it is underexplained. The idea of growing the language one rule at a time is the fun part, and the gap between a real interpreter and a bare list of names made me grin. Not deep, but it gave me a useful itch.

pages.title: FlogScript
pages.reaction: A GolfScript cousin with three data types and a huge builtin library, where the whole point is squeezing programs down to a few symbols. Lovely, but I'm not sure it clarifies my eight-symbol rules; it mostly makes me want to write a Brainfuck interpreter in FlogScript just to see how short it gets.

pages.title: 99 bottles of beer
pages.reaction: A song that every new esolang is forced to sing, like a tourist's first photo of a new city. The Batch and Uiua versions are funny: one is painfully plain, the other looks like someone sneezed on a keyboard. It shows how little the test proves, which fits my own Brainfuck project.
